import json
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import receipt, file_sha256

p = Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json')
ledger = json.loads(p.read_text())
for session in ledger['sessions']:
    if session['kernel'].endswith('-validate-staged'):
        session['hours'] = session['script_wall_seconds'] / 3600
        session['hours_basis'] = 'Downloaded script runtime only; allocation startup and output-finalization billing remain unknown.'
p.write_text(json.dumps(ledger, indent=2) + '\n')
record = {
    'provenance': receipt({'purpose':'record unavailable computer-use transport while independent CLI and local work continue'}),
    'kernel': 'nicolascoquelet/makemarketbench-qwen3-8-27b-training',
    'last_downloaded_progress': 'results/kaggle/qwen38-training-v4/progress/step500-runtime.json',
    'last_download_receipt': 'results/kaggle/qwen38-training-v4/progress/step500-download.json',
    'exact_errors': ['Sky Computer Use native pipe startup failed', 'The browser access host is unavailable'],
    'recovery_attempts': ['Reset persistent computer-use runtime', 'Select Chrome browser again', 'Re-read documentation and request enabled-surface inventory'],
    'official_sdk_fallback': json.loads(Path('runs/kaggle_draft_output_check.json').read_text()),
    'status': 'blocked_live_draft_output_retrieval; training phase since last downloaded progress is unknown',
    'independent_work': 'Batch CLI monitors continue every 610 seconds; local MLX training and sequential NIM batch continue under their locks.',
    'constraint': 'Do not restart or replace the useful interactive training session before trained outputs are preserved. CLI Quick Save exposes no explicit live-draft Save Output setting.',
    'calculation_source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'source_sha256': file_sha256(__file__),
}
Path('results/training/kaggle_ui_outage.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
